name: English Major
faculty: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences

requirements.title: Students complete 120 units, as specified below+

sections.title: Lower Division Requirements

requirements.title: Students complete any two 100-division English courses
requirements.note: Such courses may include: ENGL 111W, ENGL 112W, ENGL 113W, ENGL 114W, ENGL 115W, ENGL 199W

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students also complete any four 200-division English courses. Such courses may include.

sections.note: Students wishing to major in English are strongly advised to submit a formal declaration to this effect to the undergraduate advisor upon completing all lower division requirements.

sections.title: Upper Division Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: An English major must complete 32 units in upper division English courses.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: A minimum of eight of these units must be at the 400-level, excluding directed studies courses (ENGL 490, 491).

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: A minimum of four units must be from the following group of courses, focused on Canadian and/or Indigenous literature.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: The department may designate up to eight units of program-related upper division courses that are offered by other departments as being acceptable in fulfilling part of the required units in the major program.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students must maintain at least a 2.00 grade point average in ENGL courses.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: +SFU-Exeter accelerated law dual degree program students completing a major in English must complete the requirements listed above.

sections.note:
With permission of the department, other English courses of equivalent content may be substituted for those required in this group.
*The department may designate up to 12 units for English majors in the SFU-Exeter accelerated law dual degree program.
To view full requirements for this program, please see https://www.sfu.ca/students/calendar/faculties-research/faculty-arts-social-sciences/ba-alp.html .

sections.title: Elective Courses
sections.note: In addition to the courses listed above, students should consult an academic advisor to plan the remaining required elective courses.
